fields.description: Issue includes editor’s mail and commentary on local taxation and economic conditions; a continuing investigative series analyzing the City of Miami’s bus agreement with the Miami Beach Railway company (contract terms, fares, transfers, and limits on city control); reporting and opinion on oil-lease speculation and drilling west of Miami along the Tamiami Trail; local civic complaints about policing and public services; and regular columns and features including society notes, sports coverage (boxing, golf, tennis), and assorted local humor and advertisements.
